puzzle_identity: SHA256(canonical display-position hash plus exact solution line). Alternatives and cross-source equivalents remain separate pending verification.
opening_identity: SHA256(domain, opening name, ECO and canonical UCI path); transpositions link position hashes without deleting paths.
game_identity: SHA256(domain, event/site/date/round/players/result/variant, initial FEN and UCI mainline); raw PGN variations retained.
composition_identity: Source ID, genre and stipulation; no merge based solely on FEN.
not_claimed: automatic objective proof from an engine score
